item.title: Deputies arrest man accused of molesting 15-year-old girl
item.description: BATON ROUGE -&nbsp;The East Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office arrested a man on Saturday for allegedly molesting a juvenile.&nbsp;On Aug. 30, Johnnie Fluker, 34, allegedly inappropriately touched a 15-year-old girl.According to EBRSO arrest documents, the girl told multiple people close to her, as well as Chat GPT, about the alleged incident. item.title: Belle River Bridge closed to marine traffic due to low water levels
item.description: PIERRE PART -&nbsp;The Belle River Bridge is closed to marine traffic due to low water levels, the Assumption Parish Sheriff's Office announced on Sunday.&nbsp;"With the impending north winds, water levels are expected to continue dropping," deputies said.Drivers travelling in the area are encouraged to observe the flashing traffic board warnings and to drive slowly as they cross the bridge, as significant drops on the bridge aprons are expected until water levels increase.&nbsp;Permalink| Comme

item.title: Fire department says ash falling from sky due to sugarcane fields burning in West Baton Rouge

item.title: Louisiana State Police reveal details about fatal crash in Zachary
item.description: ZACHARY -&nbsp;The Louisiana State Police revealed information about a fatal crash that took place around 7 p.m. in East Baton Rouge Parish on Saturday.According to investigators, 68-year-old Leon McKneely of Zachary was killed when a Ford Fusion traveling northbound on La. 67 near Wilmore Drive allegedly struck McKneely, who was walking in the center of the northbound lane.McKneely was pronounced dead on the scene, while the driver was uninjured.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: LSU women's basketball dominates Alabama State to finish non-conference slate undefeated
item.description: BATON ROUGE - The LSU women's basketball team ended their non-conference schedule with a dominant win over Alabama State Sunday.The Tigers beat the Hornets 109-41 to improve to 14-0 this season, finishing their non-conference slate undefeated for the second straight season.LSU had 27 steals in the game, leading to 28 fastbreak points.
